description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimulus types used in a study, as indicated by the central label “Stimulus Type.” The chart contains seven slices representing different categories. The largest slice, colored red, is labeled “Draft/Other” and represents approximately 26.4% of the total. “Press Release” is represented by a yellow slice at approximately 18.7%, while “External News Article” is shown as a blue slice at 18.1%. A green slice represents “Email” at 2.7%, and a purple slice represents “Event Posting” at 6.6%. “Organizational Report” is shown as a dark blue slice at 7.7%, and “Organizational Website” is a lighter blue slice at 4.9%. Finally, “Interview” is represented by a dark grey slice at 8.8%. The chart includes percentage labels positioned next to each slice, and a legend is not present. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
